title: T-minus 72hr ops handoff digest
content:
Purpose: quick personal prep + meeting agenda for 1:1s and the core ops handoff sync happening T-72h. This is a working scratchpad — use for talking points and to capture owners and immediate action items.

Quick status snapshot (subject to last-minute infra tests):
- Canary cluster health: 97% pass on smoke flows (low token lengths). 3 failing traces tied to cuda OOM spikes during extended sequences — Diego digging in.
- Latency: p50/p95 within SLO on small batch profile, p99 shows +120ms on peak path. Might be quantization runtime variance.
- Error budget: remaining 6.8% for the week across hosted routes.
- Infra capacity: Dedicated pool auto-scale tested — cold start ~18s for new instance, but steady throughput OK.

Agenda for 1:1 with Marcus (release marshal) — 30m
- Quick roll call: owners and backup contacts (2 min)
- Confirm canary acceptance criteria (Marcus) (5 min)
- Risks: cuda OOM traces & mitigation plan (Diego) (8 min)
- Rollback plan walkthrough + pre-signed rollback ticket (me) (7 min)
- Final gating questions + go/no-go trigger check (5 min)

Core ops handoff sync (45m) — attendees: release marshal, infra SRE, serving-runtime lead, console, product PM
- Readouts: canary metrics + top 3 failures (5m)
- API contract smoke results (schema/shapes) (5m)
- Observability: dashboard links, exact alert thresholds we will use during launch window (10m)
- Cutover steps and cadence (who flips feature flags, who monitors) (10m)
- Contingency: cross-region fallback + gating for automatic rollback (10m)
- Final go/no-go call timeline (5m)

Minimum go/no-go checklist (quick yes/no by release marshal):
- [ ] Canary success per acceptance criteria (runbook section 2) — owner: Marcus (status: in_progress)
- [ ] No new high-severity errors in last 6h (owner: Priya) (status: open)
- [ ] DB migration dry-run completed & verified (owner: Diego) (status: done)
- [ ] Latency SLO p95 <= target on load profile (owner: observability) (status: in_progress)
- [ ] Rollback playbook validated, rollback PR queued (owner: Alyssa) (status: in_progress)
- [ ] Customer-facing comms draft ready + approvals (owner: comms) (status: open)

Immediate action items (T-72h -> T-48h):
- Diego: isolate OOM trace set + attempt small-batch-only runner to repro. ETA: 2026-03-12 EOD. (linked: JIRA:INF-2987)
- Priya: confirm alert routing to on-call + add a temporary suppression for flaky low-priority alerts. ETA: 2026-03-12 noon.
- Marcus: finalize canary acceptance sheet and add final test vectors. ETA: 2026-03-12 16:00. (linked: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/Release+Train+3.4)
- Alyssa (me): create pre-signed rollback PR and smoke-run cookbook. ETA: 2026-03-13 09:00. (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5423)
- Comms: draft short notice for customers with instructions for opt-out and contact. ETA: 2026-03-13 noon.

Open questions / notes to self:
- Q: If OOM traces reoccur at scale, do we prefer limiting max sequence length for the first 6 hours or enabling auto-fallback to smaller-quant model? (Pros/cons: customer impact vs risk surface). Bring to 1:1.
- Need a quick runbook check: who has the DB migration rollback key? Confirm with infra-sre before go.
- Double-check pricing telemetry for dedicated pool during rollout — avoid expensive over-provisioning.

Session prep checklist (personal):
- Print key dashboard links into Slack pinned message (done)
- Prepare 2-line summary for exec update if go/no-go flips to NO (template in Confluence) (todo)
- Load test with sequence-length=2048 profile one more time on canary (scheduled overnight)

Message snippets I can use in the sync (copy-ready):
- "Canary metrics show broad stability; two small OOM traces under investigation — mitigation in flight, not blocking if no new regressions in next 12h."
- "If we hit OOM repeats at scale, plan A is temporary sequence cap for 6 hours; plan B is model fallback — decision at the release marshal call."

After-sync immediate follow-ups (T+0–T+3h):
- Publish concise decisions + owner list to #release-ops channel (Alyssa)
- Create follow-up Jira for any post-sync action and assign priority (Marcus)

Misc scratch reminders:
- Bring up the question about canary traffic split percentage — default 1% might not surface certain latency cases; consider 2–3% morning window.
- Remember to breathe. Last-minute stuff always surfaces.

End of digest. Keep this doc live — copy sections into meeting minutes doc after sync.
